post.description:
### Summary

This endpoint allows you to create a callback subscription for a specific event.
When the specified event occurs, the system will send a notification to the provided callback URL.

Supported events:

- `order.completed`
  - An event notification emitted when an order has completed processing.
- `order.interpreted`
  - An event notification emitted each time new interpretation results are available for a submitted order.
  - Note, this event may occur one or more times depending on the evidence types requested and the specific workflows of the submitted order.

To unsubscribe, use the returned `subscriptionId` with the `Unsubscribe` endpoint.

### Request Model Example

```json
{
  "eventId": "order.interpreted",
  "url": "https://my.domain/callback"
}
```

### Response Model Example

```json
{
  "subscriptionId": "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"
}
```

### Callback Payload Example

```json
{
  "caseId": "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000",
  "orderId": "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174001",
  "eventName": "order.interpreted",
  "subscriptionId": "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"
}
```

## Callback Payload Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#",
  "title": "WebhookPayload",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "caseId",
    "orderId",
    "eventName",
    "subscriptionId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "caseId": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "guid",
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$"
    },
    "orderId": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "guid",
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$"
    },
    "eventName": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1
    },
    "subscriptionId": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "guid",
      "minLength": 1,
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}\\b-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$"
    }
  }
}
```
